result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, with the oldest first within each priority. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the new order, so your T-1 to T-5 example isn't covered by one.

In `SupportTicketStore.java`, I moved the sales rep's priority ordering into a shared constant, `HIGHEST_PRIORITY_FIRST`. `listOpenInRegion` and `listOpenOfSalesRep` both use it now, so the two lists can't drift apart. I also updated the Javadoc on `listOpenInRegion`.

Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still excluded, as before. The overview was the only caller of `listOpenInRegion`.
